observed: Search context, category rail and large photographic listing appear before most facts.
why: Location is explicit before browsing.
weaknesses: Photo-first hierarchy is weak for tasks without photos.
do_not_copy: Lodging imagery, favourites badge, category artwork or full arrangement.
translation: Let the task scope and real timing lead; location remains easy to change.

observed: A dated focus view uses readable task rows and selective small secondary indicators.
why: The next obligation is scannable without repeated containers.
weaknesses: Checkbox completion is not a marketplace lifecycle.
do_not_copy: Its star branding or immediate one-tap task completion.
translation: Home attention can use concise reason-led rows opening the authoritative subject.

method: Official release text read; not live-app tested
observed: The release describes coordinated discovery, trips, profiles and messaging across service types.
why: A shared account can retain context across different intentions.
weaknesses: Travel categories and booking rules differ.
do_not_copy: Trip taxonomy, proprietary illustrations or booking/payment behavior.
translation: Use one account with two entry intentions and a shared work history.

observed: Tabs name stable destinations; action initiation has a different role.
why: Stable labels reduce orientation cost.
weaknesses: Platform-specific presentation needs Android adaptation.
do_not_copy: Exact glass geometry or treating create as a destination.
translation: Keep destination identity while experimenting with composition and contextual create actions.

observed: Contextual teaching and postponing nonessential setup reduce the initial burden.
why: People learn while doing a meaningful task.
weaknesses: Required USKOČI checks still apply.
do_not_copy: Long compulsory tutorial or removing necessary consent.
translation: Introduce only the next useful capability; let publishing and earning lead to relevant setup.

observed: Price-labelled map pins, search/filter controls and category rail were visible.
why: Some useful facts are available before opening a listing.
weaknesses: Top controls are dense; selected-preview behavior was not observed.
do_not_copy: Per-night price meaning, artwork or assumed selected-sheet interaction.
translation: Use truthful task labels and fewer controls; investigate selected-pin continuity separately.

observed: Selection, readable annotations and keeping map content understandable are explicit concerns.
why: Spatial context survives the act of choosing.
weaknesses: MapKit-specific APIs do not prescribe our provider.
do_not_copy: Exact pin style or private-location precision.
translation: Coordinate pin and preview selection while preserving public-location privacy and visible context.

observed: A scoped sheet needs understandable dismissal; stacking sheets confuses return context.
why: Users can distinguish committing an edit from leaving it.
weaknesses: A prolonged interview needs more room than a small sheet.
do_not_copy: Nested sheet chains, single Done-only exit, exact platform shape.
translation: Use one focused edit surface; preserve draft and make cancellation truthful.

observed: Standard and modal sheets have different interaction roles; the drag target is accessible.
why: Choice of modality determines whether the map remains usable.
weaknesses: Its stock geometry is not USKOČI art direction.
do_not_copy: Mechanical 28dp radius or a sheet as the whole product.
translation: Define whether map context stays interactive; give handle and dismissal adequate targets.

observed: The listing groups title, place, capacity and reputation beneath a large photo.
why: Decisive facts are grouped before detailed description.
weaknesses: Hero photo consumes too much space for a text-led task.
do_not_copy: Photo dependency, lodging metrics or ornamental trust claims.
translation: Create a readable task brief with real place, time, amount and relevant person evidence.

observed: Category and place lead to skills/reviews, availability, details and confirmation.
why: Capability and availability precede commitment.
weaknesses: Its one-person invitation model differs from USKOČI.
do_not_copy: Single-worker restriction, exact steps, rates or payment policy.
translation: Expose capability and actual offer terms while retaining our multi-person task semantics.

method: Browser screenshot, upper viewport including keyboard edge
observed: An expanded item edits title/notes while the list context remains visible.
why: Editing focuses attention without a large preliminary form.
weaknesses: A personal to-do does not require marketplace publication review.
do_not_copy: Silent save/completion rules or keyboard assumptions.
translation: Use direct local fact correction followed by explicit whole-task review.

observed: Persistent labels, appropriate field size and logical focus support input.
why: People retain field meaning after typing.
weaknesses: Does not decide the interview strategy.
do_not_copy: Placeholder-only labels or fixed-height multiline input.
translation: Clear units and labels; long Serbian input stays editable above the keyboard.

observed: Suggestions sit above a compact composer; microphone and voice controls are distinct.
why: Input remains the immediate next action.
weaknesses: This is a historical screen; full voice is outside first release.
do_not_copy: Model chooser, branding, voice button implying unsupported conversation.
translation: Keep text and dictation modes clear and preserve unsent text while switching.

observed: Speaker labels and open text blocks separate request and response.
why: Long answers remain readable without nested panels.
weaknesses: A snapshot does not prove streaming or error behavior.
do_not_copy: General chatbot chrome or long replies when a short question suffices.
translation: Let interview dialogue breathe; show extracted facts only when useful.

method: Browser opened preview; inspected upper conversation and AX contents
observed: Bubble conversation, quick suggestions and a composer appear in a static assistant concept.
why: Prompt suggestions can reduce first-message effort.
weaknesses: Preview claims reminder completion without demonstrated operations; no live backend tested.
do_not_copy: Decorative emoji bot, dark glow, unverified success language or source code.
translation: Use optional starters only when draft is empty; never claim a saved result before confirmation.

observed: Conversation design considers context, ambiguity and when simpler input is preferable.
why: Questions can resolve only the information still missing.
weaknesses: Voice examples do not authorize speech output in our first release.
do_not_copy: Chat for every numeric choice or repetitive requests for known facts.
translation: Ask one useful question and offer direct correction of structured facts.

observed: Identity and reputation totals share a compact evidence block above further profile content.
why: Basic identity and supporting evidence can be read together.
weaknesses: Large enclosing card and travel metrics are not a worker skill profile.
do_not_copy: Invented years, verification or ratings.
translation: Place real reputation near identity, then skills and availability.

observed: Public profile information is distinct from private account information and viewing context.
why: Identity can support trust without disclosing everything.
weaknesses: Its host/guest model is not a new USKOČI role switch.
do_not_copy: Private details or irrelevant travel history.
translation: Build public evidence from permitted fields; keep account/security controls separate.

observed: An offer explains amount, included work and suitability.
why: The decision has comparable terms rather than only a greeting.
weaknesses: Airtasker fees/escrow are outside our approved product model.
do_not_copy: Payment assurance, bidding mechanics or their policy.
translation: Show actual offered amount, timing and message with a final review.

observed: A specific stay heading and property photo precede check-in/out details.
why: The detail identifies the exact commitment.
weaknesses: Large media delays the next consequential action; lower controls not inspected.
do_not_copy: Travel hero treatment, cancellation or payment assumptions.
translation: Lead with exact task, participants and current next action; accepted terms remain readable.

observed: Rating, distribution, review count and sorting are separate signals.
why: A count gives context to an average.
weaknesses: Laurel badge and huge number overstate confidence for a new marketplace.
do_not_copy: Guest-favourite award, fabricated distribution or unimplemented metrics.
translation: Use only backend-supported reputation, explicit no-review state and readable contrast.

observed: Calendar days contain editable time blocks; invitation availability is a separate switch.
why: Working intervals and accepting invitations are different decisions.
weaknesses: Its hour limits and calendar rules differ.
do_not_copy: Specific limits or changes to our eligibility rules.
translation: Explain saved intervals separately from current willingness to accept work.

observed: Selected range has visible endpoints, summary and clear-dates action.
why: Users can see the result of a range choice before leaving.
weaknesses: Overnight ranges are not recurring work availability.
do_not_copy: Night counts or unavailable-date policies.
translation: Give a human-readable time summary and reversible editing of the actual schedule.

observed: Date groups and relative day labels organize upcoming items with separators.
why: Time is scannable without a calendar grid.
weaknesses: Large empty gaps are wasteful for dense work schedules.
do_not_copy: Day imagery or interpreting no tasks as available.
translation: Offer a compact agenda view; distinguish unknown availability from free time.

method: Official search excerpt read; limited coverage
observed: Concise context-sensitive notification text is emphasized.
why: An event can explain why it matters at a glance.
weaknesses: Excerpt-only evidence does not establish a full inbox or deep-link flow.
do_not_copy: Assumed authorization, payload privacy or untested grouping rules.
translation: Explain the event and open its exact subject while preserving access checks.

observed: Meaningful graphical controls require discernible contrast against adjacent colors.
why: Rating choice can remain perceptible without guessing pale shapes.
weaknesses: Not every decorative border is an interactive component.
do_not_copy: Color-only selected stars.
translation: Use readable shape/edge plus selection state and accessible labels.

method: Transcript portion read; video not watched
observed: Persistent destinations, hierarchical movement and focused modal tasks serve different purposes.
why: Back behavior follows the type of transition.
weaknesses: An older iOS presentation is not an Android visual specification.
do_not_copy: Hiding destinations during routine browsing or copying platform decoration.
translation: Model destination, drill-down and temporary editor distinctly; verify native Back.

observed: Navigation destinations stay consistent; the flexible bar adapts to compact and medium windows.
why: Destination continuity supports orientation across views.
weaknesses: Native ergonomics do not prescribe our brand shape or exact arrangement.
do_not_copy: A dated baseline bar, automatic pill styling or role-based destination changes.
translation: Compare stable labelled destinations at compact widths and under Android system navigation.
